paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Samuel a-upata a, Israel mite tung a vaihawmmi in atapate abawl hi.
heading: Mipite'n Kumpipa Angen Uh
english: When Samuel was old, he made his sons judges over Israel.

paite: Ata masapen min Joel ahi a, azom min Abijah ahi. Amaute Beer-sheba a vaihawmte ahi uh.
english: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah. They were judges in Beersheba.

paite: Himahleh atapate'n ama omdan ala kei ua, sum-le-pai adelh ua, golhna ala ua, dik a vaihawmna akaikawi uhi.
english: His sons didn’t walk in his ways, but turned away after dishonest gain, took bribes, and perverted justice.

paite: Huchi in Israel mite upate tengteng akikhawm ua, Ramah ah Samuel kiang ah ahoh uhi.
english: Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together and came to Samuel to Ramah.

paite: Akiang ah, "Ngai in, na upa mahmahta a, na tapate'n lah na omdan ala kei hial uh. Namdang tengteng bang a ka tung ua vaihawm ding kumpipa hon bawlsak in," achi uhi.
english: They said to him, “Behold, you are old, and your sons don’t walk in your ways. Now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.”

paite: Himahleh akiang a, "Ka tung ua vaihawm ding kumpipa hon pia in," achih un Samuel akipaksak kei hi. Huchi in TOUPA kiang ah Samuel athum hi,
english: But the thing displeased Samuel when they said, “Give us a king to judge us.” Samuel prayed to Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N Samuel kiang ah, "Mite'n na kiang a agen tengteng uh ngaikhia in. Nang hon deih lou ahi kei ua, atung ua kumpipa dia kei hon deih lou ahi zaw uhi.
english: Yahweh said to Samuel, “Listen to the voice of the people in all that they tell you; for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected me as the king over them.

paite: Aigupta gam a pan ka pikhiak ni a pan tutan a athilhihdan tengteng uh, hon lehngatsan a pathian dangte nna ahon sepsan zel uh mah bang in nang tung ah ahih uhi.
english: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even to this day, in that they have forsaken me and served other gods, so they also do to you.

paite: Huaiziak in athu uh ngaikhia in. Himahleh chitaktak in vauhilh inla, atung ua vaihawmmi kumpipa tatdan ding kawkmuh in," achi hi.
english: Now therefore, listen to their voice. However, you shall protest solemnly to them, and shall show them the way of the king who will reign over them.”

paite: Samuel in TOUPA thu tengteng kumpipa ngen mipite ahilh vek hi.
english: Samuel told all Yahweh’s words to the people who asked him for a king.

paite: "Na tung ua vaihawmmi ding kumpipa tatdan hichibang ahi ding. Na tapate uh ala dia, amah mah a ding, sakol kangtalai a ding leh asakol tungtuang mite ding in asep ding. Akhente asakol kangtalai ma ah atai ding uh.
english: He said, “This will be the way of the king who shall reign over you: he will take your sons and appoint them as his servants, for his chariots and to be his horsemen; and they will run before his chariots.

paite: Asepaih sangkhatte heutu ding leh sawmngate heutu ding asep dia; khenkhatte alei let ding, abuh la ding, agalvante bawl ding, akangtalai van bawl ding in azang ding hi.
english: He will appoint them to him for captains of thousands and captains of fifties; and he will assign some to plow his ground and to reap his harvest; and to make his instruments of war and the instruments of his chariots.

paite: Na tanute uh gimlim bawl ding, anhuan ding leh tanghou bawl ding in azang ding hi.
english: He will take your daughters to be perfumers, to be cooks, and to be bakers.

paite: Na lou, na grephuan, olive huan a ahoih tata ahon sut dia, asikhate ape ding hi.
english: He will take your fields, your vineyards, and your olive groves, even your best, and give them to his servants.

paite: Na haichi leh na grephuan a sawm-a-khat ahon laksak dia; asikhate leh heutute ape ding hi.
english: He will take one tenth of your seed and of your vineyards, and give it to his officers and to his servants.

paite: Na sikhapate, na sikhanute, na tangval hoihhoihte leh na bawngte ahon sut dia, anasem ding in azang ding.
english: He will take your male servants, your female servants, your best young men, and your donkeys, and assign them to his own work.

paite: Na belamhon lak a sawm-a-khat ahon laksak dia; nou asikhate na hi ding uh.
english: He will take one tenth of your flocks; and you will be his servants.

paite: Huai hun chiang in na tel ding uh kumpipa ziak in na kapkhe ding uh. Himahleh huai hun chiang in TOUPA'N ahon ngaikhe kei ding," achi hi.
english: You will cry out in that day because of your king whom you will have chosen for yourselves; and Yahweh will not answer you in that day.”

paite: Himahleh mipite'n Samuel thu azui nuam kei uh, "Ahi kei, kumpipa i neih ngeingei ding uh ahi.
english: But the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel; and they said, “No, but we will have a king over us,

paite: Huchi in namdang tengteng bang i hong hi dia, i kumpipa'n vai ahon hawmsak dia, i namte pi in galte ahon doupih ding," achi uhi.
english: that we also may be like all the nations; and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.”

paite: Samuel in mipite thugen tengteng aza a, TOUPA bil ah agensawn hi.
english: Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N Samuel kiang ah, "Athu uh la inla, kumpipa bawlsak in," achi hi. Samuel in Israel mite kiang ah, "Michih noumau khua chiat ah paita un," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Samuel, “Listen to their voice, and make them a king.” Samuel said to the men of Israel, “Everyone go to your own city.”
